facts.fact: 警局失窃：厕所全被偷，警察说"没有线索可循"——nothing to go on 既指没线索又指没东西可坐/踩
facts.anchor: The police station has been broken into and all the toilets stolen. Officers say they have nothing to go on.

facts.fact: 警车轮胎被偷，警察将"不辞辛劳"（tirelessly，字面"无轮胎地"）追查
facts.anchor: All the police cars in the area have had their wheels stolen, so officers will be working tirelessly to find the culprits.

facts.fact: 宠物店被窃，警察说"没有线索"——leads 又指狗绳
facts.anchor: The pet shop nearest the police station has been burgled. Officers say they have no leads.

facts.fact: 警局灯全被偷，警察说"很高兴"——因为终于"有亮点/bright side"或"看清了"
facts.anchor: All the lamps have been stolen from the police station. Officers say they are delighted.

facts.fact: 裸体营围栏破了个洞，警察说"正在调查"——look into 字面"往里看"
facts.anchor: A hole has been found in the fence of a nudist colony. Police say they are looking into it.

facts.fact: 假发厂三吨头发被窃，警察"在梳理该地区"——comb 既是梳理也是搜捕
facts.anchor: Three tons of hair has been stolen from a wig factory. Police are combing the area.

facts.fact: 霸王龙因卖枪被捕，罪名是 small arms dealing——既指"小型武器交易"，又指"小短手"
facts.anchor: A Tyrannosaurus rex has been arrested for selling guns, and charged with small arms dealing.

facts.fact: 警方新得一万只蜜蜂，用于 sting operation（钓鱼执法，sting 又指蜇）
facts.anchor: Local police have recently acquired 10,000 bees. They are to be used in a sting operation.

facts.fact: 运红漆与蓝漆的两船相撞，两船船员都 marooned（困在荒岛，maroon 又指栗红色）
facts.anchor: A ship carrying red paint and a ship carrying blue paint have collided in the middle of the ocean. Both crews are marooned.

facts.fact: 警方寻找穿狼人装的嫌犯；若找不到，就"继续穿平常制服找"——把 in a werewolf costume 误接到警察身上
facts.anchor: Police are looking for a criminal in a werewolf costume. And if they don’t find him, they’ll keep looking in their normal uniforms.

facts.fact: 宠物店丢了两只兔子，却找回六十八只——数字荒谬（源自"两兔繁殖"的荒谬算术）
facts.anchor: Two rabbits were stolen from a pet shop last week. Only sixty-eight have been recovered.

facts.fact: 偷电池与烟花两人被捕，一个被 charge（充电/起诉）、一个被 let off（放电/释放）
facts.anchor: Two men have been arrested for stealing batteries and fireworks. Police charged one and let the other one off.

facts.fact: 一帮香肠被控共谋，警察"在烤问"——grill 既是审讯又是烧烤
facts.anchor: A gang of sausages have been charged with criminal conspiracy. Police are grilling the suspects.

facts.fact: 监狱里犯人喊编号代替讲笑话，全场大笑——因为大家都熟记笑话清单
facts.anchor: A man gets sent to prison and is amazed when, during lunch, a prisoner stands up and shouts, ‘Seventy-two!’ and everyone falls about laughing.

facts.fact: 狱友解释：待得太久，所有笑话都记住了，只消报编号
facts.anchor: ‘We’ve all been here for so long that we know all the jokes,’ says his cellmate.

facts.fact: 新犯人终于喊出"三十八号"，全场死寂
facts.anchor: One lunchtime he stands up and says, ‘Thirty-eight!’ There is stony silence.

facts.fact: 狱友摇头说"问题在你讲的腔调"——把 ch03"怎么讲比讲什么重要"的笑点放进监狱元笑话
facts.anchor: His cellmate looks at him, shakes his head and says, ‘It’s the way you told it.’

facts.fact: 偷斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴书的贼，警方警告勿靠近——"他有小提琴前科"，history of violins 谐音 history of violence
facts.anchor: Police hunting a robber who stole a book about Stradivarius have warned the public not to approach him. He has a history of violins.

facts.fact: 别对偷了你院门的罪犯说话，他可能"take a fence"（take offence 生气）
facts.anchor: What do you say to a dangerous criminal who’s stolen your gate? Nothing. He might take a fence.

facts.fact: 咖啡杯被窃，警方公布 mugshots（嫌犯照，mug 又指杯子）
facts.anchor: All the police station’s coffee cups have been stolen. They have released some mugshots.
